text:
jordan: Heads-up — seeing a spike in multi-GPU jobs failing in eu-west with peer resets during NVLink setup. Started ~08:12 UTC. Jobs hit 50% failures for a couple of runs :confused:
eli: Any logs? nccl or kernel?
maggie: got a quick grep from a failing worker, looks like ibverbs connect reset: 
```
Jul 12 08:12:15 gpu-node-12 kernel: mlx5_core 0000:05:00.0: MLX5: connection error on QP 2345: retry exceeded (last opcode SEND)
Jul 12 08:12:15 gpu-node-12 nccl: NCCL WARN NET/IB : peer 10.10.5.3 failed to connect: ERR - Remote QP state
```
amit: interesting — link still up? any port counters?
jordan: link shows up, but rx_packets_drop increased on mlx5 from 0 -> several hundred in minutes. Ran `ethtool -S` and `ibv_devinfo` quick checks.
eli: could be RX credits starvation or PFC interaction. Any recent QoS/qdisc changes on ToR or host?
maggie: checked switch config, no PFC changes in our runbook. But there was a policy push to enable egress policing on the fabric around 07:50 (ticket NET-4598).
ops-oncall: pinging infra-net team, attaching traceroute & qdisc: 
```
# on gpu-node-12
$ sudo tc qdisc show dev eth0
qdisc mq 0: root 
# traceroute 10.10.5.3
1  tor1 0.4ms 0.3ms 0.3ms
2  agg2 0.7ms 0.6ms 0.6ms
3  10.10.5.3 0.9ms
```
eli: that policing could drop small RoCE v2 UDP packets if meter misclassifies, leading to RDMA stall & QP retries -> resets. Also RX credits on mlx5 rely on timely flow control packets.
jordan: repro steps: run synthetic allreduce with 4xA100s across nodes a/b, runs fine when we disable fabric policy; flaky when enabled.
amit: try `ib_write_bw -F -D 5000` and `ibv_rc_pingpong -R` to see reorders/latency. Also capture `tcpdump -n -i ib0 udp` to watch RoCE headers.
maggie: ran ibv_rc_pingpong -> saw latency spike + 100% retrans on QP at the same time as policing rollout window. Attached pcap snippet (trimmed).
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1382 (RDMA packet drops correlated with fabric egress metering).
ops-oncall: temporary mitigation: pin critical jobs to `dedicated-gpu-pool-2` which uses an older ToR config (no egress policing). Starting migration of queued runs now.
eli: long-term: need explicit match rule to exempt RoCEv2 UDP 4791/33434 range (our policy currently matches UDP by 5-tuple) and/or mark RoCE packets for higher priority. Also consider enabling RX buffer increase on mlx5 via `mlxconfig` and `sysctl net.core.rmem_max`.
jordan: patching `netclass` rule to ignore IB subnet? I'll open a PR for the fabric policy rollback if infra agrees.
amit: also test kernel `mlx5_core` 5.14 vs 5.16 behavior — there was a regression earlier around RX credit handling.
ops-oncall: moving running jobs now; new runs in 30m. We'll keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
maggie: notes for postmortem: correlate NET-4598 rollouts with failed job timestamps, include pcap and `ethtool -S` series, and recommend policy exception for UDP RoCE marking.
jordan: thanks team — will follow up with PR link and timeline. If anyone sees other nodes with similar spikes drop a note here.
ops-oncall: closed-loop: fabric team acknowledged misclassification, rolling targeted rollback to affected ToRs. Next update in 15m.
